title: First-ever EU tripartite agreement signed to boost energy storage
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Jun 2026 The European Commission has rallied a number of EU energy ministers, storage developers and manufacturers, renewable energy developers, energy-consuming industries and financial institutions around the first-ever EU tripartite agreement on energy storage.
